record.title: Match retained OPEN and stream-ready observations without claiming device action
record.intent: Reuse the distinction between a matching protocol reply and completed instrument behavior.
requirements: Select exactly one client OPEN by expected payload digest and match its local identifier to server ready replies under explicit ambiguity and identifier rules.
Return named ready missing or rejected outcomes and preserve the difference between matched protocol evidence TCP delivery total event order and completed device action.
Expose only offline delegated CLI inspection with payload and identity redaction, and compare a preserved reboot-delivery transcript as a positive or reproducible profile-negative result.
Exercise public installed library and CLI consumers without changing any old verifier or physical artifact.
acceptance: Synthetic ambiguity controls and preserved evidence comparison establish the narrow matching claim.
